title: PR3: Strict location / work-type filters
description:
## Why
location_fit and work_type only soft-score; cannot hard-drop mismatches.

## What
- location.strict_location_fit, strict_work_type (default false)
- collector drops at store when strict
- emailer/outreach respect strict
- Profile UI checkboxes

## Acceptance
- Strict location + excluded job → not stored
- Strict work_type + onsite-only + remote job → not stored
- Flags off → identical to today
close_reason: Implemented strict_location_fit and strict_work_type (default false). Collector and rescore drop mismatches when on; outreach respects flags. Profile UI checkboxes + tests + changeset.

title: PR2: Profile-selectable job boards
description:
## Why
Remotive/RemoteOK/Arbeitnow always run — inject remote noise for onsite searches.

## What
- search.job_board_sources on profile (empty = all, compat)
- collector only enables listed sources
- Profile UI checkboxes

## Acceptance
- Profile with only jsearch → only jsearch in collect
- Empty sources → all four (today behavior)
close_reason: Profile search.job_board_sources filters collector; UI checkboxes; empty=all. Tests green.

title: PR1: Honest location defaults + onsite heuristic
description:
## Why
Missing location currently defaults to Remote (misleading). Bare city strings get work_type=unknown instead of onsite-ish.

## What
1. Stop defaulting unknown location to Remote — use Unknown
2. Bare place location (no remote/hybrid keywords) → work_type=onsite

## Files
- core/models.py: location default Unknown
- sources/greenhouse,lever,ashby,jsearch,arbeitnow,html_scraper: fallbacks
- core/scorer.py: detect_work_type heuristic
- core/database.py: CREATE default Unknown for new DBs only

## Acceptance
- Empty location → Unknown, not forced remote
- Austin TX + no remote text → onsite
- Remote · US → remote
- Hybrid NYC → hybrid
close_reason: Implemented: Unknown location defaults, onsite heuristic for bare cities, tests

title: Epic: Multi-location / onsite-capable job hunter
description:
Make the tool first-class for any location strategy (remote, hybrid, fixed onsite). Covers follow-ups 1-7 from analysis.

Success: fixed-location onsite user can import preset, disable remote boards, strict-filter, seed multi-geo companies. Remote users keep current defaults.

See plan session for full design.

title: Generalize matching + location/work-type preferences
description: Replace India checks and tech-specific framing with generic skills matching, preferred locations, and Remote/Hybrid/On-site work types. Destructive schema OK. Also: user-set email TZ/time, rewrite seeds, LinkedIn DM templates with tokens.
close_reason: Generalized matching: skills instead of tech, location_fit + work_type instead of India; user email TZ/time; DM templates with tokens; seeds rewritten

title: Require feature branches + changesets for agent work
description: Update AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md so agents: (1) never work on main — create a branch that includes bead issue ID(s); (2) run changesets for every commit with meaningful changes.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md document branch naming with bead IDs, ban working on main, and require a changeset for meaningful commits; .changeset/README.md notes non-interactive agent workflow.
close_reason: Documented mandatory feature branches (with bead IDs) and changesets for meaningful commits in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .changeset/README.md

description:
## Why
No preset models fixed-location onsite searcher.

title: Dockerize app + compose + Docker Hub release + Changesets
description: Dockerize FastAPI job-hunter, add docker-compose, GitHub Actions release to stanidesis/job-hunter, and Changesets for version/changelog. No HOST env — container binds 0.0.0.0 internally; users access localhost:PORT.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up works; release workflow on non-chore main + manual; changesets version PR; DB volume persists
close_reason: Docker, compose, release workflow, and Changesets implemented

title: Migrate daily digest from Gmail SMTP to Resend
description: Remove Gmail SMTP/app-password entirely. Send digests via Resend API with RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM, RESEND_TO. Update emailer, settings, main, .env.example, profile UI, and all docs.
acceptance_criteria: No Gmail path remains; Resend SDK used; docs and .env.example updated; profile recipient override works against RESEND_TO
close_reason: Gmail SMTP removed; digests send via Resend (RESEND_API_KEY/FROM/TO); docs and .env.example updated
